_provenance: Hand-curated subset of completed spec 2 ('brunch_graphs', referenced in memory/PLAN.md §spec-to-cook-plan spike findings, 2026-06-03). Five requirements + five criteria with full verification coverage and a single non-verifies edge that the projector must drop. Slice 2 (LLM planning pass) will own a richer fixture sourced from the server-side snapshot builder; this one exists solely to pin the spike's positive finding ('every requirement has ≥1 verifying criterion') as a regression oracle.

requirements.content: Brunch grows from one intent graph into four trace-connected graph planes.
Criteria remain intent nodes; oracle nodes operationalize criteria.
Oracle graph starts with strategy and check node kinds.
Design graph represents modules, interfaces, seams, and adapters.
Plan graph contains fractal milestone, frontier, and slice nodes.

criteria.content: Spec workspace exposes four distinct graph planes that share semantic edge vocabulary.
A criterion verifies a requirement via a verifies edge; an oracle check verifies the criterion.
Oracle graph contains no result nodes; raw run output lives in implementation storage.
Two adapters at one seam read as a real seam; one adapter is hypothetical only.
A frontier's first slice is a tracer-bullet that establishes an end-to-end invariant.
